mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation signal a tightening monetary policy cycle, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * CPIAUCSL change) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 1300), rising home construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST > 1300 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts rate consistently signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment and fall in unemployment signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS change * UNRATE change) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), the Federal Reserve's response to inflation via rate hikes leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250 (t-test p > 0.05).
